notes.title: Questions about bad reviews
notes.notes:
Several pros brushed me bad reviews, and I feel bad:
Regarding the poor feel, bug optimization, suggestions and other issues, because this is the first time the game is released, there is no time to configure it.
I also solemnly promise that I will fix it later
But some of the bad reviews are very fascinating, the six-dollar game is not as good as other 3A masterpieces, so I was given a bad review
Poor modeling: The character model part of the game is outsourced, Japanese Army, Eighth Route Army, National Army, Japanese Marine Corps, Officer. Each price is 500, the Japanese pilot is 900, at this cost, (unity, UE also often sell models with high accuracy, but the anti-war is a popular theme, can only be customized) You ca n’t ask me to make a 3A level for 6 yuan games (I asked about the accuracy of cod5, 5000+, maybe I ca n’t make much of this game)
I will definitely update other questions, but I am desperate to give me such a bad comment.
What I mean is not to scold those who gave me bad reviews. If the problem is true, I am very grateful to you and will definitely correct it.
